baseline.compliance_statement: NO compliance certification is claimed. This is an engineering baseline inventory, not an attestation.

authentication_assumptions.model: session cookie auth (middleware) over an in-memory session store; users in data/users.json (gitignored)
gaps: sessions are in-memory — restart invalidates them

baseline.authorization_model: E5 RBAC: 10 roles x 22 permissions enforced at the /api/enterprise dispatcher; denials audited; dev-admin default for local development
baseline.audit_log: append-only, hash-chained (sha256 prev-hash); verifyAuditChain exposed via API; tampering is detectable
baseline.artifact_storage: local filesystem: public/runs (run artifacts, gitignored), data/enterprise/store.json (gitignored runtime state)

secrets.handling: .env.local (gitignored) holds all API keys; secret_scan.mjs guards tracked files; enterprise docs/demo data are scanned

baseline.network_calls: pipeline optionally calls supplier APIs (DigiKey) with keys from env; enterprise layer makes NO external calls; no payment integration

data_retention.note: no automatic deletion; runtime stores are local files — retention policy is a deployment decision

export_controls.note: artifact export controls not implemented; flagged for the on-prem/tenant-isolation milestone

baseline.customer_data_handling: demo data is synthetic; customer reports scrub local paths; evidence artifacts stay on the deployment host

deployment_modes.local_prod: next build + next start (validated on this machine, port 4500)
deployment_modes.on_prem: viable: file-backed stores, local binaries, no external dependencies required at runtime — packaging is a next milestone
deployment_modes.cloud: possible but NOT hardened: single-tenant assumption, in-memory sessions, local file stores

known_gaps: no at-rest encryption of local stores
IP/session fields in audit log are placeholders

known_runtime_issues: Tailwind v4 oxide scanner CRASHES on multi-MB binaries in non-gitignored paths (silent worker death -> TurbopackInternalError on globals.css; dev hangs). Guards: *.glb gitignored + @source not "../public" in globals.css. Any new generated binary must be gitignored BEFORE the next build.
next start holds the port across rebuilds — kill by PID from lsof -t -iTCP:<port> before restarting, or EADDRINUSE serves the STALE build
pcbnew (kipython) requires crash-isolated subprocesses for fixture suites (M3A harness does this)
plain-ESM .mjs modules are shared between Next API routes and node test scripts — keep them dependency-free

allowed_runtime_matrix.webpack build: works via next build --webpack; not the default
allowed_runtime_matrix.windows: NOT validated (kicad paths are macOS-specific in scripts)
